description: Deployment configuration for mod-inventory-update using folio-vertx-lib 4.0.1 and Vert.x 5.0.4. Reference baseline: bugfest with 3 standalone tenants and 11 consortia tenants. Baseline deployment settings were not supplied: values below are source defaults, not verified bugfest measurements. Null environment values require deployment-specific input or retain library defaults as described. CPU, memory reservation and sidecar recommendations remain unspecified pending baseline verification. Sources: descriptors/ModuleDescriptor-template.json, Dockerfile, README.md (Deployment note), and https://github.com/folio-org/folio-vertx-lib/blob/v4.0.1/core/src/main/java/org/folio/tlib/postgres/impl/TenantPgPoolImpl.java. No sidecar implementation or version is specified by this module; empty sidecar arrays indicate recommendations are pending, not that a sidecar needs no configuration. HTTP port is a JVM system property (http.port or port, default 8080), not an environment variable. Tenant-level import settings are outside this artifact’s scope.

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Container memory hard limit in bytes from ModuleDescriptor launchDescriptor.dockerArgs.HostConfig.Memory; not verified against bugfest.

java.name: MaxRAMPercentage
java.description: Maximum heap percentage of container memory, matching ModuleDescriptor JAVA_OPTIONS.

deployment.description: README Deployment note: import APIs do not support multiple running module instances. Run one replica and avoid overlapping replicas during rollout.

kong.description: Provisional standard Kong proxy timeouts, following mod-circulation and mod-orders DeployConfig.json conventions. No module-specific timeout is defined in this repository; verify against the bugfest gateway before adoption.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options consumed by the container launcher; matches ModuleDescriptor and the java section.

EnvVars.name: VERTICLE_FILE
EnvVars.description: Application jar filename set by Dockerfile for the container launcher.

EnvVars.name: VERTICLE_HOME
EnvVars.description: Application jar directory set by Dockerfile for the container launcher.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL host supplied by the deployment. Supports {tenant} substitution.

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL port; standard Vert.x PostgreSQL client default.

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name supplied by the deployment. Supports {tenant} substitution.

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL username supplied through deployment secret management. Supports {tenant} substitution.

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL password supplied through deployment secret management; no credentials are stored here.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum connections per pool; Vert.x PoolOptions default. folio-vertx-lib shares pools for equal connection options across tenants within the process.

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of retries after a failed database connection attempt; Vert.x default disables retries.

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTINTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Delay in milliseconds between database reconnect attempts; Vert.x default. Relevant when DB_RECONNECTATTEMPTS is positive.

EnvVars.name: DB_SERVER_PEM
EnvVars.description: Optional PEM CA certificate chain. When supplied, folio-vertx-lib enables VERIFY_FULL, HTTPS hostname verification and TLSv1.3. Leave unset to retain the default connection options.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAX_LIFETIME
EnvVars.description: Maximum pooled connection lifetime in milliseconds; folio-vertx-lib explicitly defaults to 30 minutes.
